meta.name: KONFRM color tokens
meta.status: approved foundations with documented implementation defaults

primary.purpose: Primary action, active selection and focus identity.
primary.allowedUse: Primary CTAs, active navigation and focus indicators.
primary.prohibitedMisuse: Do not use as a decorative page fill or an inactive-state color.

primaryHover.purpose: Pressed or hover response for a primary control.

primarySoft.allowedUse: Selected rows, informative callouts and icon wells.

accent.allowedUse: Small, intentional highlights or limited attention cues.
accent.prohibitedMisuse: Never use as the normal primary CTA, a large surface, or body-text color.

primary.purpose: Cards, controls, sheets and primary content surfaces.

elevated.purpose: Modal, bottom-sheet and elevated card surface.

primary.purpose: High-contrast text only; not a standard page or card surface.

muted.purpose: Metadata, placeholders and low-priority supporting text.

inverse.purpose: Text on an approved high-contrast control.

default.purpose: Standard card, input and divider border.

success.purpose: Confirmed, completed and verified states; not a brand color.

warning.purpose: Pending, draft or attention-needed states; not a brand color.

danger.purpose: Errors, rejected and destructive states; not a brand color.

info.purpose: Informative and in-progress states; not a second brand color.

disabled.purpose: Disabled control surface; pair with disabled text and semantics.

focusRing.purpose: Visible focus halo; never remove focus indication.

policy.note: A dark neutral may be used only as a text token where contrast requires it. It is not a standard KONFRM surface.
